narrative.overview: The pass is the counter between the kitchen and the dining room: dark, ordered, lit only where something is ready to go. Quanela reads the same way. Most of the screen is a quiet night surface; information sits in hairline-bordered cards and tables; the brightest ink appears only where the person has to act or where something needs them.
keyCharacteristics: Night surfaces with hairline borders; depth by tone, shadow only on what floats.
One range: the theme's ink for action, focus, live state and selection; ember orange only for the brand (ADR 0073).
Inter with tabular figures; small type set with uppercase micro-labels.
Pills for actions and filters, softly rounded cards, gently rounded fields.
Light, dark and neutral themes from one token set; AA contrast in all three.

rules.name: The One Range Rule
rules.body: The app speaks in one range: the neutral scale of its theme. Action, focus, live state and selection use the theme's ink; orange belongs to the brand, never to a control (ADR 0073).

rules.name: The Honest Zero Rule
rules.body: A figure that is not known yet is «—» in a muted tone, never a 0 and never a green «all good».

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that can be compared uses tabular figures and is formatted, never raw.

rules.name: The Only-What-Floats Rule
rules.body: A surface that stays in the flow of the page has no shadow. Shadow means «this is above the page and will go away».

dos: Do keep the app in one range: actions, focus and live state in the theme's ink (The One Range Rule).
Do keep orange for the brand (logo, landing, welcome); never as a button, link or active state.
Do show unknown figures as «—» and empty or failed states with what happened and what to do next.
Do use the shared components in src/shared/ui instead of hand-made variants.
Do honor reduced motion: transitions keep only a short fade, nothing moves.
donts: Don't animate anything endlessly on an operational screen (no pulsing «live» dots, no count-up numbers).
Don't put white text on #f97316 or invent new sizes below 11 px.
Don't add shadows to cards that stay in the page, gradients on text, decorative glass or eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't use a colored side border thicker than the 2 px state stripe of the order card.
Don't invent customers, figures or testimonials anywhere in the product or the landing.
